relations.subject: Peter Francis Kornicki
relations.evidence: He matriculated at Lincoln College, Oxford, initially to read Classics. He graduated with First Class Honours in Japanese with Korean in 1972.

relations.subject: Peter Francis Kornicki
relations.evidence: He spent the academic year 1972-3 as a Japanese Ministry of Education foreign student at Tokyo University of Education (now Tsukuba University)

relations.subject: Peter Francis Kornicki
relations.evidence: then returned to Oxford and in 1975 received an MSc in Applied Social Studies.

relations.subject: Peter Francis Kornicki
relations.evidence: He then moved to St Antony's College, Oxford to begin work on a DPhil on Japanese literature of the Meiji period.
